headline: 11,000 YEARS AGO SOMEONE TRIED TO INVENT POTTERY
display: 11,000 years ago, someone in Turkey tried to invent pottery… and it didn't quite work.
At a site in Mardin called Çemka Höyük, archaeologists found 46 pieces of fired clay.
They come from at least 9 different objects, some of the earliest fired clay containers in this part of the world.
Different shapes. Different clay mixtures. Like someone testing ideas.
Some may have been clay coatings wrapped around food… and baked in the fire.
Real pottery would only become common centuries later.
So who was the first person to try it… 11,000 years ago?
